content.title: Did USA women's basketball win today? FIBA game score vs. Spain
content.text: Kara Lawson is the team’s head coach. Monique Billings Paige Bueckers Rae Burrell Caitlin Clark Kahleah Copper Chelsea Gray Dearica Hamby Rhyne Howard Kiki Iriafen Kelsey Plum Angel Reese Jackie Young Team USA schedule All game times are ET. March 11: USA 110, Senegal 46 March 12: USA 91, Puerto Rico 48 March 14: USA 93, Italy 59 March 15: USA 101, New Zealand 46 March 17: USA 84, Spain 70 Live updates: Team USA women’s basketball vs. Spain Below the photo gallery, the Times Union provided updates during today’s game. Article continues below this adKelsey Plum, right, dribbles during the USA women's basketball team's game against New Zealand on Sunday, March 15, 2026, in Puerto Rico.USA Basketball Final score: USA 84, Spain 70 6:33 p.m.: The United States wraps up a perfect showing in Puerto Rico.Kahleah Copper scores 20 points to lead the Americans.Article continues below this ad USA women’s basketball on way to blowout win vs. Spain 6:25 p.m.: Kahleah Copper has 20 points and the USA owns a 75-58 lead midway through the fourth quarter.Kelsey Plum has 13 points for the USA. Caitlin Clark nearing double-double 6:20 p.m.: Caitlin Clark has seven points and seven rebounds early in the fourth quarter.Article continues below this adKahleah Copper has scored a team-best 20 points, as USA leads 66-52. Kahleah Copper, Kelsey Plum, Dearica Hamby leading USA 6:18 p.m.: After three quarters, Kahleah Copper has a team-best 15 points.Kelsey Plum and Dearica Hamby each have 10 points.Article continues below this ad USA women’s basketball live score update 6:15 p.m.: After three quarters, the U.S. team leads Spain 61-47. Paige Bueckers getting going for USA 6:09 p.m.: After a slow start, Paige Bueckers is up to seven points.Article continues below this adThe USA leads 58-44 late in the third quarter. USA on way to perfect FIBA tournament 6:07 p.m.: The United States is up 58-42 late in the third quarter.Kahleah Cooper leads the U.S. with 12 points.Article continues below this ad Caitlin Clark back into the game for USA 6:02 p.m.: With the USA ahead 51-38, Indiana Fever star Caitlin Clark comes back into the game for the Americans. USA Basketball surging to huge lead 6 p.m.: All the sudden, the lead is 51-34 for Team USA.Article continues below this adKahleah Copper with a team-best 12 points. Second half underway 5:55 p.m.: The USA is 20 minutes away from a perfect stay in San Juan. Kelsey Plum, Dearica Hamby leading USA Basketball 5:43 p.m.: While Kelsey Plum has 10 points for the USA, Dearica Hamby has added eight.Article continues below this adHamby also has a team-best four rebounds. Caitlin Clark making impact 5:42 p.m.: In today’s first half, Caitlin Clark has scored five points and dished four assists in 11 minutes. At the half: Team USA leads Spain 44-32 5:40 p.m.: At the break, the United States owns a 12-point lead.Article continues below this adKelsey Plum has 10 points to lead the USA. It’s a busy week for USA coach Kara Lawson 5:38 p.m.: After leading Team USA in Puerto Rico, Kara Lawson goes back to the college game later this week.Her Duke Blue Devils are a No. 3 seed in the NCAA Tournament. Lawson’s college team plays Friday against Charleston.Article continues below this adShe has coached Duke since 2020 and was named the 2026 ACC Coach of the Year after leading the Blue Devils to the ACC regular-season championship for the first time in 13 years. Appointed coach of Team USA in September 2025, Lawson is in her first tournament leading Team USA as head coach. Caitlin Clark leading USA in assists 5:34 p.m.: Against Spain, Caitlin Clark has a team-high four assists late in the second quarter.Clark also has five points.Article continues below this adThe USA leads 40-30. USA Basketball lead grows to 10 5:32 p.m.: After some early strong play from Spain, Team USA has opened up a 38-28 lead.Kelsey Plum leads the USA with 10 points.Article continues below this ad Kelsey Plum starring for USA 5:28 p.m.: The WNBA star guard is up to eight points and the USA lead is 34-23. Team USA opening up lead vs. Spain 5:24 p.m.: The USA has surged to a 30-23 lead. Kelsey Plum is up to seven points.Article continues below this ad Megan Gustafson leading Spain 5:23 p.m: Megan Gustafson has scored seven points, and Spain is tied with the USA at 21 early in the second quarter. Score update: USA Basketball 21, Spain 16 5:18 p.m.: After one quarter, Team USA owns a slim lead.Article continues below this adDearica Hamby has six points to lead the Americans. Caitlin Clark puts USA ahead 5:15 p.m.: A pair of free throws for Caitlin Clark puts the USA ahead 16-15 late in the first quarter.Paige Bueckers celebrates during the USA women's basketball team's game against New Zealand on Sunday, March 15, 2026, in Puerto Rico.USA Basketball Angel Reese, Paige Bueckers into game for USA Basketball 5:10 p.m.: The U.S. continues to go to the bench and has taken a 12-11 lead late in the first quarter.Article continues below this ad Caitlin Clark checks in for USA 5:07 p.m.: Caitlin Clark is the first USA player off the bench.Spain leads 9-8 midway through the first quarter. Danilo Gallinari is calling today’s game 5:05 p.m.: Danilo Gallinari, one of the commentators for tonight’s game, is a former professional basketball player from Italy and is the highest-scoring Italian player in NBA history.Article continues below this adHe was selected sixth overall in the 2008 NBA Draft by the New York Knicks and also played for the Denver Nuggets, LA Clippers, Oklahoma City Thunder, Atlanta Hawks, Washington Wizards, Detroit Pistons, and Milwaukee Bucks.Over his 16-season career in the NBA, he averaged 14.9 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 1.9 assists per game. Game underway, Team USA vs. Spain 5 p.m.: The United States is on the court, seeking a 5-0 stay in Puerto Rico.Article continues below this ad4:56 p.m.: Looking to watch today’s game between the USA and Spain?It’s available on TNT or HBO Max. Team USA starting lineup 4:54 p.m.: Today’s starting lineup for Team USA is out.Article continues below this ad Dearica Hamby Kahleah Copper Chelsea Gray Rhyne Howard Jackie Young Kara Lawson’s Team USA coaching staff 4:44 p.m.: Assistant coaches for USA basketball for this tournament are Nathan Tibbetts, Jose Fernandez, Natalie Nakase and Stephanie White.Angel Reese is shown during the USA women's basketball team's game against New Zealand on Sunday, March 15, 2026, in Puerto Rico.USA Basketball Previewing USA women’s basketball today vs. Spain 4:38 p.m.: In the Puerto Rico tournament, the United States and Spain are the two highest-scoring teams.Article continues below this adThe United States is averaging 98.8 points per game and Spain is scoring 82.5.While the U.S. is 4-0, Spain is 3-1. Spain lost to Italy. Team USA women’s basketball schedule today on TV 4:33 p.m.: Today’s game vs. Spain starts at 5 p.m. ET and is available to watch on TNT or HBO Max.Article continues below this ad FIBA World Cup qualifier 4:23 p.m.: Before play even began around the world in qualifying tournaments, five teams were already qualified for September’s World Cup. Germany automatically advanced as the host nation, while the winners of the 2025 continental championships also earned direct entry to the tournament.Besides Germany, the teams that had already qualified were: Belgium: EuroBasket Women 2025 champions United States: FIBA Women’s AmeriCup 2025 champions Australia: FIBA Women’s Asia Cup 2025 champions Nigeria: FIBA Women’s AfroBasket 2025 champions Article continues below this ad FIBA MVP vote underway 4:14 p.m.: A fan vote is underway to crown an MVP of the qualifying games in Puerto Rico.Paige Bueckers, Angel Reese and Caitlin Clark are among the U.S. players able to be voted for in the contest. Former UConn basketball star Paige Bueckers playing big Team USA role 4:10 p.m.: UConn legend and Dallas Wings standout Paige Bueckers is off to a great start to her career playing for U.S. senior team.Article continues below this adIn four appearances, Bueckers is averaging 11 points, two rebounds and 2.3 assists per game. Bueckers is No. 3 on Team USA in scoring and fifth overall in the FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup qualifying tournament games being played in Puerto Rico. Caitlin Clark leading USA basketball 4:02 p.m.: In her debut for the senior national team, Caitlin Clark is starring.The NCAA’s all-time leader in scoring is averaging a team-best 12.8 points per game for Team USA and leading the club in assists at 6.3. Clark is leading the entire tournament in assists per game and ranks No. 3 in scoring.Article continues below this ad Megan Gustafson leading Spain 3:58 p.m.: The top player on Spain is Megan Gustafson, who is averaging 14.5 points per game.In the WNBA, the 6-foot-2 Gustafson plays for the Las Vegas Aces. Rhyne Howard coming off big game 3:50 p.m.: In Team USA's latest win, a 101-46 drubbing of New Zealand, Rhyne Howard led the squad with 18 points. Coming off the bench, Howard made 6 of 10 shots from 3-point range.Article continues below this ad Caitlin Clark, USA basketball face toughest opponent 3:40 p.m.: The United States is 4-0 at the FIBA World Cup qualifier and hasn’t been played closer than 34 points.That should change today.While the U.S. team is No. 1 in the world rankings. Spain is No. 6.Article continues below this ad
